title: Defending an Attack
intro: Choose the situation you face and follow the response in order.

sections.title: Leadership takes priority
paragraphs: This guide is made so you do not have to panic and make costly mistakes when you are under attack.
In all cases, R4/5 ingame leadership will have priority rather than this guide.
As this only serves as a guideline for you, when R4/5 are not around.

sections.title: Your base is targeted
items: Enable a shield if you are not in war frenzy.
Make sure your base is being defended by the correct heroes. You can view this by clicking on your walls inside your base.
Activate an attack and defense boost.
Notify R4/5 through discord or other means.
Teleport or use a shield whenever you can.

sections.title: An ally’s base is targeted
items: Try to use a shield on your own base.
Teleport next to the tribe members base.
Send reinforcements to help its defense.
Notify R4/5 through discord or other means.
Do not get war frenzy yourself.

sections.title: A tribe flag is targeted
items: Notify R4/5 through discord or other means.
Activate an attack and defense boost.
Teleport 2 flags behind the flag that is currently under attack. So when that flag gets destroyed, you are still in tribe territory.
Reinforce the flag. But make sure a T7 player is present, to become the defender/captain of the flag.
Wait on further instructions from R4/5.

sections.title: A tribe structure is targeted
items: Notify R4/5 through discord or other means.
Activate an attack and defense boost.
Teleport nearby.
Reinforce the structure. But make sure a T7 player is present, to become the defender/captain of the flag.
Wait on further instructions from R4/5.
